scope: Vercel source-staging reproducibility falsification and deterministic Git-blob transport candidate; not whole-machine acceptance and not a current-main EntityOS receipt.

negative_results.inference: Because the raw TAR hash changed, gzip metadata and the removed commit PAX header cannot by themselves explain the cross-hook mismatch.

grf.generated_hypothesis: The exact committed Git tree can be transported reproducibly if source bytes and executable/symlink semantics are derived directly from immutable Git tree/blob objects and the archive encoder fixes every header field itself.
grf.strongest_counter_reality: A custom archive encoder may silently change source semantics, mishandle paths/symlinks/executable modes, or remain deterministic only on a toy tree while failing on the product tree.
grf.discriminator: First require a local isolated utility test for repeated byte identity plus extraction semantics; then require repeated Vercel build hooks on the exact product candidate to emit identical TAR and gzip digests before any merge or Sandbox promotion.

mechanism: enumerate committed files with git ls-tree
read bytes only with git cat-file blob
normalize ordinary executable modes from Git mode bits
preserve symlink targets from symlink blobs
emit deterministic USTAR with fixed uid/gid/mtime/header fields
exclude only the explicit staging exclusions
build TAR twice in-process and fail closed unless byte-identical
